body: Removed the divider and excess space below the counter actions menu, leaving an 8px gap to the next section. Other section spacing and functionality are preserved. Full gate passes 251 Rust, 137 JavaScript and 12 Python tests; card-layout/counters pass in Chromium and WebKit, with 24 visual geometry cases. Rebuilt/restarted the existing manual app: HTTPS/build assets verified; all 38 prior resource versions, two pins, preferences and certificate preserved. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-counter-footer-spacing.md. Physical-device and full release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Remove excess space below the counter menu
